All publications of the IB2 group.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pubs = FileAttachment("_generated/publications.json").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
categoriesOf = (d) => (d.keyword ?? "").split(",").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
allCategories = Array.from(new Set(pubs.flatMap(categoriesOf))).sort()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof activeCategories = Inputs.checkbox(allCategories, {label: "Filter by category"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
filtered = activeCategories.length === 0
  ? pubs
  : pubs.filter(d => categoriesOf(d).some(c => activeCategories.includes(c)))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
yearOf = (d) => d.issued?.["date-parts"]?.[0]?.[0] ?? 0
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sorted = filtered.slice().sort((a, b) => yearOf(b) - yearOf(a))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<p class="text-muted">${sorted.length} of ${pubs.length} publications shown.</p>
<ol class="pub-list">${sorted.map(formatEntry)}</ol>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function formatAuthors(authors) {
  if (!authors) return "";
  return authors.map(a => a.literal ?? `${a.given ?? ""} ${a.family ?? ""}`.trim()).join(", ");
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
function formatEntry(d) {
  const year = yearOf(d) || "n.d.";
  const journal = d["container-title"] ?? "";
  const vol = d.volume ? `, vol. ${d.volume}` : "";
  const issue = d.issue ? ` (${d.issue})` : "";
  const pages = d.page ? `, ${d.page}` : "";
  const link = d.DOI ? `https://doi.org/${d.DOI}` : d.URL;
  const abstractBlock = d.abstract
    ? html`<details><summary>Abstract</summary><p>${d.abstract}</p></details>`
    : "";
  return html`<li class="pub-entry mb-3">
    <div class="pub-title fw-bold">${d.title}</div>
    <div class="pub-meta">${formatAuthors(d.author)} (${year}). <em>${journal}</em>${vol}${issue}${pages}.
      ${link ? html` <a href="${link}" target="_blank">link</a>` : ""}
    </div>
    ${abstractBlock}
  </li>`;
}
```
